test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The stranger said to me “What is your name?”

options.text: The stranger has asked me what is my name
The stranger asked me what my name was.
The stranger asked me what was my name.
Told me what my name is.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The stranger asked me what my name was."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:

 
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Present Tense.
 
• Simple Present Tense changes to Simple Past Tense.
 
• Remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• Do not use 'that' in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb 'said/said to' is changed in asked, demanded, ordered, enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the question mark in the sentence of Indirect speech.
 
• The word **"your" **changes to **"my" **in reported speech.
 
• The question is changed to assertive form and is simply placed after the reporting verb.
 
• Example:
 
 
• John said to me, "What is my occupation?" (Direct speech)
 
• John asked me what my occupation was. (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct answer: *The stranger asked me what my name was.*
